every-euro-keeps-running-supporters: Every euro keeps {NAME} running: pledge monthly, or give once if you would rather not commit to anything. Both count on the podium below, and the badge on your player page comes with a monthly pledge. Nothing is ever locked behind it and there will never be ads.
is-free-open-source-and: {NAME} is free, open-source and ad-free, and it runs at a loss. No ads, ever. If it is useful to you, chip in what you want, monthly or just once, and keep the World of Tanks tracker alive and growing.
it-runs-on-a-single: It runs on a single rented server, and every euro goes back into the project: the server, the database, the Wargaming-whitelisted egress IPs that let us refresh more players, and the occasional push to get it in front of more people. Supporters cover the monthly bill; anything extra goes into more throughput and new features.
no-ads-no-investors-no: No ads, no investors, no data selling. {NAME} is funded entirely by the people who use it.
no-supporters-yet-be-the: No supporters yet. Be the first on the podium.
ranked-by-the-total-given: Ranked by the total given since launch, monthly pledges and one-off donations alike.
same-numbers-as: The exact same numbers as the {link}.
